# Dr. Akiva Elad: Dental Implants & Aesthetic Dentistry, Tel Aviv

> Dr. Akiva Elad's clinic in Tel Aviv: immediate-loading dental implants, bone grafting, dental aesthetics and fully digital dentistry. Over 30 years of experience.

Hebrew name: ד"ר עקיבא אלעד (ד"ר עקיבא אלעד | השתלות שיניים ואסתטיקה בתל אביב).

## About Dr. Akiva Elad

A graduate of the Hebrew University–Hadassah School of Dental Medicine in Jerusalem (1989), Dr. Elad is one of the pioneers of immediate loading in Israel and worldwide, with over 30 years of experience in implants, bone grafting and advanced surgery.

He serves on the board of the Israeli Association of Oral Implantology (IAOI), develops new treatment methods and bone graft materials, and lectures at conferences in Israel and abroad. In his Tel Aviv clinic he leads a fully digital approach: 3D scanning, computer-aided planning and CAD-CAM production.

- 1989: DMD, Hebrew University–Hadassah, Jerusalem
- 1990s: Among the first worldwide to apply immediate loading
- 2014: Involved in developing the NOVAMag® magnesium membrane from the very first idea
- 2023: Lead author of two papers on bone regeneration with magnesium membranes
- Today: IAOI board member, lecturer and method developer

Facebook (personal): https://www.facebook.com/akiva.elad

## Publications (Dr. Akiva Elad, lead author)

- **Application of Biodegradable Magnesium Membrane Shield Technique for Immediate Dentoalveolar Bone Regeneration**. Elad A, Rider P, Rogge S, Witte F, Tadić D, Kačarević ŽP, Steigmann L. *Biomedicines 2023; 11(3): 744*. A technique for immediate bone regeneration in damaged extraction sockets: a resorbable magnesium membrane serves as the missing socket wall, as an alternative to autologous bone or partial root retention. Four clinical cases showed good bone regeneration and soft-tissue healing at four months. [Full text](https://www.mdpi.com/2227-9059/11/3/744) · [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36979728/)
- **Resorbable magnesium metal membrane for sinus lift procedures: a case series**. Elad A, Pul L, Rider P, Rogge S, Witte F, Tadić D, Mijiritsky E, Kačarević ŽP, Steigmann L. *BMC Oral Health 2023; 23: 1006*. A case series in which a resorbable magnesium membrane was used to repair tears and perforations of the sinus membrane during sinus lift procedures. All cases showed successful healing and new bone formation, with 10 to 20 mm of new bone height. [Full text](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12903-023-03695-4) · [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38097992/)

Video: [Dr. Giorgio Tabanella & Dr. Akiva Elad about NOVAMag®](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I3bhQG4msFI) (botiss biomaterials, 2023, 2:41). Dr. Elad has been involved in the NOVAMag® project since the idea was born in 2014. In this official botiss video, he and Dr. Giorgio Tabanella of Rome talk about the launch of NOVAMag®, the world's first product line of bioresorbable magnesium for oral regeneration, and how it enables minimally invasive approaches for complex treatments.

## Treatments

- **Immediate-loading implants**: Implants and provisional teeth are placed on the same day. You leave the clinic with a complete, stable and aesthetic smile, with no toothless waiting period.
- **Bone grafting & regeneration**: Sinus lift, socket preservation and ridge reconstruction, using graft materials and techniques Dr. Elad develops and teaches in Israel and abroad.
- **Aesthetics & oral rehabilitation**: Porcelain veneers, zirconia crowns and full rehabilitation, digitally designed so you can see the result before we begin.
- **Teeth whitening**: Professional, safe in-clinic whitening for a brighter, natural result after a single session.
- **Advanced surgery**: Surgical solutions for complex cases, by a surgeon with more than three decades of experience.
- **Hygiene & prevention**: Professional cleaning, guidance and ongoing maintenance, because your new smile should stay that way for years.

## Patient journey

1. **Consultation**: A personal meeting, 3D scan and digital imaging.
2. **Treatment plan**: Computer-aided planning, a clear explanation and transparent pricing.
3. **Treatment**: Precise execution of the plan, with minimal discomfort.
4. **Smile & follow-up**: You leave with a new smile, and we keep supporting you.

## FAQ

### What is immediate loading?

A method in which implants and provisional teeth are placed on the same day, so you are never left without teeth during healing. Dr. Elad is one of the world pioneers of this method.

### Is the treatment painful?

Treatment is performed under local anaesthesia with a minimally invasive approach. Most patients report only minimal discomfort.

### What if I don't have enough bone?

The clinic specialises in bone grafting: sinus lift, socket preservation and ridge reconstruction, so nearly every case has a solution.

### How long do implants last?

With proper treatment and ongoing maintenance, implants can last for decades. We continue to support you after treatment.

### How do I book an appointment?

Via WhatsApp, by phone or through the form on this site. We will get back to you quickly with a consultation date.

## שאלות נפוצות (עברית)

### מה זה העמסה מיידית?

שיטה שבה השתלים והשיניים הזמניות מותקנים באותו היום, כך שאינכם נשארים ללא שיניים בתקופת ההחלמה. ד"ר אלעד הוא מחלוצי השיטה בעולם.

### האם הטיפול כואב?

הטיפול מבוצע בהרדמה מקומית ובגישה זעיר-פולשנית, ורוב המטופלים מדווחים על אי-נוחות מינימלית בלבד.

### מה אם אין לי מספיק עצם?

המרפאה מתמחה בבניית עצם: הרמת סינוס, שימור עצם ושחזור רכס, כך שכמעט לכל מקרה יש פתרון.

### כמה זמן מחזיקים שתלים?

בטיפול נכון ותחזוקה שוטפת, שתלים יכולים להחזיק עשרות שנים. אנחנו מלווים אתכם גם אחרי הטיפול.

### איך קובעים תור?

בוואטסאפ, בטלפון או דרך הטופס באתר. נחזור אליכם במהירות עם מועד לייעוץ.
